text: 🌦 NestJS 12 Released with ESM-First Packages, Rspack and Vitest The progressive framework gets its biggest release in years, going ESM-first (CJS is still an option), replacing webpack with Rspack, adding Standard Schema support for easy interop with Zod, Valibot and friends, plus structured logging, a brand new homepage, and more. Kamil Mysliwiec
